categories.label: Retail
categories.words: Up to ₹2 lakh. Most people apply here.
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 22 applicants gets one lot (an estimate, from 21.9x bids).
categories.note: Applying for more lots doesn't raise your chance: when retail is oversubscribed, each winner gets one lot.

categories.label: Small HNI (sHNI)
categories.words: More than ₹2 lakh, up to ₹10 lakh.
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 98 applicants gets the smallest application (an estimate, from 98.2x bids).

categories.label: Big HNI (bHNI)
categories.odds_words: About 1 in 157 applicants gets the smallest application (an estimate, from 157.3x bids).

odds_note: From the latest bids. They usually jump on the last day, so the odds will fall.

exits.title: Your listing-day rule
steps: Before Wed 21 Oct: decide your rule now, while you're calm, and write it in your journal.
On Wed 21 Oct, the shares start trading at 10 AM. Don't buy more on the first day's excitement.
If it opens above ₹271: you applied for a listing gain, so sell on listing day. Waiting for more turns a plan into a hope.
If it opens below ₹271: sell if it is more than 10% below your price, rather than holding on to wait for it to come back.

disclaimer: A learning aid worked out by fixed rules, not advice. Only apply with money you won't need soon, and decide for yourself.
